goal: Speed up block serialization and Initial Block Download by reducing overhead in primitive serialization
Avoid unnecessary buffering and endianness conversions during single-byte writes and size computation
agreement: Unaddressed objection: single-byte writes in sha256 add complexity without clear benefit (sedited)
Questioned whether existing stream buffering already negates the real-world IBD speedup (maflcko)
Support for faster block serialization, noting potential value for future kernel users (sedited, theuni)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because microbenchmarks show 10-25% faster block serialization latency and a modest ~2% IBD gain
Practical impact may be limited because production stream writes are already buffered
